# Soham Patil

> Soham Patil is a Master’s student at the Robotics Research Center (RRC), IIIT Hyderabad, working on learning for contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

This is the personal academic website of Soham Patil. All pages are static HTML and readable without JavaScript.

## Pages

- [Home](https://soham2560.github.io/): bio, news, publications, Stepping Stones (projects), experience, education, awards and teaching
- [Publications](https://soham2560.github.io/publications/): papers with abstracts, arXiv, project websites, code and posters
- [News](https://soham2560.github.io/news/): recent updates
- [CV (PDF)](https://soham2560.github.io/assets/pdf/soham_patil_cv.pdf)
